gold: Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC)

selector.rationale: The presence of multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules and a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene, along with histopathological features of buds and cords of basaloid cells, strongly supports Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome.

rejected.why: Lack of palmar or plantar pits and lower score compared to Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome
